test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MARKER' is written as 'AMXERE'. How will 'REDUCE' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/O-8dyIBISvx5o12SRtu7LEU3MrfmUur0K7yvnZtsglByfUu2KE50xGcq6Fq_nOEKo4KE6Pi8qp1t_qIoWZP27wlcEhkexo6SLy4EV_7f2vEMLUJBvfvnqxEzTXkOURl8Qxk2a4F4lUwkwpyJZID43g] 

'MARKER' is written as 'AMXERE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07b795681e93a163d6e19c9b9df692089d566e538015922b88b64910c24adbd8.png] 

Similarly,

'REDUCE' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/562a4fe9d9c799ba92a518f71b0e9b6ee818e5bd7ce99327af55ad8640f51621.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "ERJOEC".
